audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.early calls Reckless Swing 'percent-HP true damage'. It is flat true damage that also costs Olaf health, refunded only if it kills the target. Separately, spikes[1] says 'your E slow' — Mundo's slow is on Infected Bonesaw (Q); Blunt Force Trauma (E) has no slow. And phases[2] claims 'your passive shrugs the first CC' when Olaf has no immobilize at all.
audit.why: Percent-HP would mean Mundo can never buy his way out; flat true damage means his HP pool does still matter, and the self-damage means Olaf is at his weakest immediately after casting E. Mundo's passive resists the first Immobilizing effect — Undertow only slows and Ragnarok does not immobilize, so nothing Olaf owns spends the cannister; it stays banked for the enemy jungler.
audit.corrected: Damage type corrected in breakdown.early, slow attributed to Q in spikes[1], passive behaviour stated in phases[2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer and content layer both give Level 6, First item and 2+ items to 'Skill'. Content whys[4] calls 6 'his strongest window', whys[5] says first item is 'uphill for you', and whys[6] says late 'flips to you' — three rows disagreeing with their own text. The packet chart gives Olaf everything through First item and Dr. Mundo 2+ items.
audit.why: Winrate is 46.68 over 934 games. Olaf's power is front-loaded true damage and a 100s CC-immunity ult; Mundo's is compounding HP and regen. The flip genuinely happens at two items, not at six.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: Level 6 and First item to Olaf, 2+ items to Dr. Mundo, in both layers, with the three why-lines rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Ragnarok carried a number; Undertow, Tough It Out and Reckless Swing had none.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s that RESETS if Olaf picks the axe back up — walking over the axe is the single highest-value habit in the lane and the page never gave the reason. Tough It Out is 16s at rank 1 and is the shield that eats Mundo's whole burst window. Reckless Swing is 11s at rank 1, so it is not spammable.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, phases[4].why, phases[5].why and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon and tldr say 'build armor' with no caveat.
audit.why: Undertow reduces Armor on everything it passes through and Reckless Swing is true damage, so armour only answers his autos — it does not answer the ability that actually kills Mundo. Flagged in breakdown.early rather than rewriting the win condition wholesale.
audit.corrected: Damage-type correction added to breakdown.early; armour advice left standing because it is still correct against his auto-attack DPS.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Ragnarok is up.
edits.after: Your passive never fires here — nothing Olaf owns immobilises you, so it stays banked for his jungler. Poke and leave; his E out-trades you flat.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Olaf to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: Ragnarok (100s at rank 1) makes him immune to disables while he keeps swinging, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores the HP you bought. Don't fight it.

edits.before: Heartsteel timing — every proc widens the HP gap and your cleavers start hurting. Stand in the wave and dare Olaf to trade into the regen.
edits.after: Heartsteel adds HP that Reckless Swing ignores outright — it is true damage. Force out Tough It Out (16s at rank 1) before you commit to anything.

edits.before: Warmog's makes you a raid boss: full HP between every fight. Olaf needs Grievous Wounds and a jungler to even slow you down — split, soak, win.
edits.after: Now it flips: his E costs him health every cast and its damage is flat, while your pool and regen keep compounding. Long fights are finally yours.

edits.before: Olaf’s percent-HP true damage and CC-immune R out-duel an HP tank. Step on his axes, anti-heal, build armor, and avoid extended fights in his R. Track Ragnarok before every step-up.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is flat TRUE damage, not percent HP, and it costs him health too — he is lowest right after he casts it. Step on his axes and never brawl inside Ragnarok.

edits.before: - Olaf Ragnarok (100s): matchup-defining — CC-immune. Bait it before fighting. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Ragnarok (100s at rank 1): immune to disables while he keeps attacking — bait it, then fight. - Undertow (9s) resets if he picks the axe back up, so walk over it. - Tough It Out (16s at rank 1) is the shield; force it out before you commit.

edits.before: Track Olaf’s Ragnarok (100s): CC-immune. Bait it before fighting. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Ragnarok (100s at rank 1). Walk over his Undertow axe — the pickup resets its 9s cooldown and re-slows you.

edits.before: His Ragnarok (R) makes him CC-immune, so your E slow and W Heart Zapper can't kite him and your R-fueled sustain gets out-DPS'd by his true-damage E; this is one of his strongest all-in windows.
edits.after: Ragnarok (R) makes him immune to disables, so he shrugs your jungler's CC and commits freely while true-damage Reckless Swing out-paces your R sustain. It's 100s at rank 1 — bait it, then fight.

edits.before: Spam Reckless Swing (E) true damage that ignores all your HP
edits.after: Trade with Reckless Swing (E) — true damage ignores your HP
